title: YouTrackDB is a general-use object-oriented graph database
summary: YouTrackDB is a general-purpose object-oriented graph database developed by JetBrains, designed to store and manage complex object relationships in a graph structure with native support for object-oriented paradigms.
problem_solved: Provides an object-oriented approach to graph data storage, making it easier for developers to work with complex interconnected data structures without impedance mismatch.
why_valuable: Combines the flexibility of graph databases with object-oriented programming concepts, allowing seamless mapping between code objects and stored data.
